title: Departments with high bonus-to-salary ratio
prompt: Using the staff14 table, return each department along with its total salary (column total_salary) and total bonus (column total_bonus), but only include departments where total bonus exceeds 10% of total salary.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE staff14 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT, salary INTEGER, bonus INTEGER); INSERT INTO staff14 VALUES (1,'A','Eng',100000,5000),(2,'B','Eng',100000,5000),(3,'C','Sales',60000,9000),(4,'D','Sales',60000,8000),(5,'E','HR',50000,2000),(6,'F','HR',50000,2500);
reference_sql: SELECT department, SUM(salary) AS total_salary, SUM(bonus) AS total_bonus FROM staff14 GROUP BY department HAVING SUM(bonus) > 0.1 * SUM(salary);
